company_profile.business_description: Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide.

business_model.core: Development and production of specialty chemical systems and products for construction and automotive/industrial sectors

revenue_streams.description: Systems and solutions for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting in the building sector
Adhesives, sealants, and advanced material solutions for automotive, appliances, composites, and other industrial applications

competitive_advantages: Global leading position with presence in 102 countries
16 global technology centers and 100+ local R&D facilities
Strong innovation capability with digital R&D lab (Nuage)
Proven consolidator with successful acquisition track record (MBCC integration)
Local manufacturing in key markets (nearly 100% of USA sales manufactured in-country)
Strong customer proximity and value selling capability
Digital platform for retail distribution with double-digit growth

chair.name: Thierry F. J. Vanlancker
chair.title: Chair of the Board of Directors

risks.description: Challenging construction markets with double-digit decline in China's construction business; deflationary market environment in China; weakness in residential retail-driven business in China
Geopolitical tensions, macroeconomic uncertainty, tariffs uncertainty affecting market conditions
Currency headwinds, particularly weak US dollar with -4.9% impact; currency effects on reported revenues
MBCC integration completion and synergy realization (in progress; completed in 2025)

evidence: Nuage: global digital R&D lab using AI-driven insights and enabling faster collaboration
Partnership with Giatec™ Scientific Inc. for AI-driven smart concrete testing solutions
Data from global labs connected via digital laboratory with machine learning reducing experiments by up to 75% and shortening time to market by more than 50%
End-to-end digital platform for retail distribution connecting Sika, distributors, retailers, applicators, and building owners
Sika® Carbon Compass: automated platform with AI/standardized verified information on product carbon footprints
Digital concrete technology platforms with smart testing capabilities
ai_positioning.summary_fr: Sika positionne l'IA comme catalyseur d'innovation et d'efficacité opérationnelle. L'entreprise intègre l'IA dans ses laboratoires R&D (Nuage), ses tests de béton (partenariat Giatec), et ses plateformes numériques client. Les applications incluent l'accélération du développement produit (réduction de 75% des expériences), l'optimisation des processus de fabrication, et la transparence environnementale (Carbon Compass). L'IA soutient également la stratégie digitale plus large de 'Fast Forward', axée sur la transformation numérique et l'innovation accélérée.

target_markets.description: Full range of admixtures and additives for concrete, cement, and mortar production; interconnected digital tools for concrete value chain

World-leading waterproofing solutions covering flexible membrane systems, liquid-applied membranes, joint waterproofing systems, waterproofing mortars, injection resins; applications in basements, tunnels, bridges, water-retaining structures
Full range of flat roofing systems with flexible sheet and liquid-applied membranes; Sika Sarnafil® roofing systems (60+ years); green roof, solar, and cool roof solutions
Comprehensive portfolio including tile adhesives, grouts, under-tile waterproofing, decorative finishes, exterior insulation finishing systems
Solutions based on synthetic resin and cementitious systems for pharmaceutical, food production, manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare, educational facilities, parking, residential
Wide range of high-performance sealants, adhesives, spray foams, tapes for commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure construction; weatherproofing, bonding, protection applications
Repair mortars, precision grouts, chemical anchors, structural adhesives, protective coatings, corrosion control systems, advanced strengthening technologies; software tools for structural engineers

Products for automotive, commercial vehicles, industrial lamination, renewable energy, appliances, advanced resins; elastic bonding, structural adhesives, sealants, reinforcing, acoustic applications, composites and castings
